descriptions.date: Select the date of the quotation.
descriptions.dueDate: Select the due date for this quotation.
descriptions.object: Enter the object of the quotation. This is a brief description of what the quotation is about.
descriptions.enterprise: Select the enterprise for which this quotation is being created.
descriptions.interlocutor: Select the interlocutor for this quotation. The options available will depend on the enterprise you have selected.
descriptions.generalConditions: Enter the general conditions for this quotation. You can use the editor to format the text as needed.
